description.value:
Trigger Your Verse of Rot or Verse of Silence spell critically succeeds against a target.

The Verse spreads. A second creature adjacent to the original target is affected by the same Verse, at the same rank, and attempts its own saving throw against it as though it had been an original target. A critical success against that second creature does not spread further. This can trigger only once per casting, and only for a Verse of Rot or a Verse of Silence.

cinderfall.incomplete: This clause is an ongoing effect targeting a different creature's roll/HP/condition/behavior, sourced from the holder's own passive (P-CROSSCREATURE), with no selector anywhere in pf2e-source for one actor's rule element to reach into a separate actor on an ongoing basis. Searched for a "spell re-applies itself to a new target on a trigger" pattern (spell-echo/reflection feats, e.g. reflecting-force style reactions) and found nothing that duplicates a resolved spell onto a second, un-targeted creature; every real analog only redirects or reflects a spell back at its original caster/target, never propagates it forward.
